visualCharacteristics.purpose: Full-bleed rotating stage at the top of the page
visualCharacteristics.layout: one slide visible, cross-fade between slides; background image with overlaid text box
visualCharacteristics.notes: no autoplay; keyboard arrows switch slides; first slide image loads eagerly for LCP

contentPattern.structure: cell 1: image (alone); cell 2: optional eyebrow paragraph, heading (H2), text paragraph, one or two CTA links (bold = primary, italic = secondary)

usage: Homepage stage / Bühne with several campaign slides.
reuseGuidance: Use for full-width rotating hero content. For a single static hero use the hero block; for several visible teaser cards use carousel-teaser.
